title: Quentin and the Semester
author: Astrid Dravenmoor
blurb: Petra Whitlock, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
